result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The statements split the rubric evenly. A states the unit once and gives every year-over-year cell a plus sign or parentheses, with heavier totals and a distinct header; its rounded card and filled bands do extra hierarchy work, and parenthetical figures sit off the digit column. B builds hierarchy with indentation, heavier subtotals, and rules above those lines, and pads amounts so parentheses line up; the unit appears in both the subtitle and the stub header, and the restructuring year-over-year cell is n/a rather than a signed percentage. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A builds the statement with indented line items, heavier subtotals under rules, parentheses for negatives, and an explicit sign on every year-over-year percentage. B reconciles and states the unit once, with a distinct header, but shaded section bars and a bordered card carry more of the grouping, and the margin rows place percentages in the dollar columns. A follows the hierarchy and number rules more closely.
